rationale: Adds bounded redacted diagnostic-only failure certificates for the existing review execution audit. It changes review tooling and failure evidence retention without changing product behavior, tool admission, verdict sealing or merge authority.

summary.ru: Отказ ревью сохраняет ограниченную безопасную диагностику без публикации transcript или недопустимого вердикта.
summary.en: Failed reviews retain bounded safe diagnostics without publishing transcripts or admitting a refused verdict.
